queries.name: end-end tracking for request id
queries.sql:
-- Ask AI (Claude (Anthropic)): i want to track end to end data for a equipment request
SELECT er.REQUEST_NUMBER,
       er.STATUS                 AS request_status,
       er.PROJECT_NAME,
       er.TASK_NAME,
       er.CUSTOMER_NAME,
       er.REQUESTOR_NAME,
       er.REQUESTED_START_DATE,
       er.REQUESTED_END_DATE,
       rl.EQR_REQUEST_LINE_ID,
       rl.LINE_STATUS,
       rl.QUANTITY,
       rl.ALLOCATION_STATUS,
       rl.DELIVERED_QUANTITY,
       rl.CONSUMED_QUANTITY,
       rl.RETURNED_QUANTITY,
       rl.START_DATE             AS line_start_date,
       rl.END_DATE               AS line_end_date,
       em.EQUIPMENT_NUMBER,
       em.EQUIPMENT_NAME,
       ld.UNIT_TYPE,
       ld.UNIT_NUMBER,
       ld.UNIT_STATUS,
       ld.ALLOCATION_STATUS      AS unit_allocation_status,
       ld.ALLOCATED_QTY,
       ld.SOURCE_INV_ORG_NAME,
       ld.DEST_INV_ORG_NAME,
       mt.EXPENDITURE_TYPE       AS misc_exp_type,
       mt.RAW_COST               AS misc_raw_cost,
       mt.STATUS                 AS misc_status,
       sh.FROM_STATUS,
       sh.TO_STATUS,
       sh.CHANGED_DATE
FROM   EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST er
       LEFT JOIN EQR_REQUEST_LINE rl
              ON rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST_ID = er.EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST_ID
       LEFT JOIN EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER em
              ON em.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID = rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID
       LEFT JOIN EQR_V_LINE_DETAIL_UNITS ld
              ON ld.LINE_ID = rl.EQR_REQUEST_LINE_ID
       LEFT JOIN EQR_LINE_MISC_TXN mt
              ON mt.EQR_REQUEST_LINE_ID = rl.EQR_REQUEST_LINE_ID
       LEFT JOIN EQR_REQUEST_STATUS_HISTORY sh
              ON sh.EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST_ID = er.EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST_ID
WHERE  er.REQUEST_NUMBER = :request_number
ORDER BY rl.EQR_REQUEST_LINE_ID,
         ld.UNIT_NUMBER,
         sh.CHANGED_DATE
FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY;

queries.sql:

-- Ask AI (Claude (Anthropic)): i need the query for TCO for selected equipment
WITH line_cost AS (
    SELECT rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID,
           SUM(NVL(rl.ESTIMATED_COST, 0)) AS est_rental_cost
    FROM   EQR_REQUEST_LINE rl
    WHERE  rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID IN (:equipment_master_ids)
    GROUP  BY rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID
),
misc_cost AS (
    SELECT rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID,
           SUM(NVL(mt.RAW_COST, 0)) AS misc_cost
    FROM   EQR_LINE_MISC_TXN mt
           JOIN EQR_REQUEST_LINE rl
             ON rl.EQR_REQUEST_LINE_ID = mt.REQUEST_LINE_ID
    WHERE  rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID IN (:equipment_master_ids)
    GROUP  BY rl.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID
),
posted_cost AS (
    SELECT pcd.EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID,
           SUM(NVL(pcd.TOTAL_COST, 0)) AS posted_cost
    FROM   EQR_PROJECT_COST_DETAIL_V pcd
    WHERE  pcd.EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID IN (:equipment_master_ids)
    GROUP  BY pcd.EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID
)
SELECT em.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID,
       em.EQUIPMENT_NUMBER,
       em.EQUIPMENT_NAME,
       NVL(lc.est_rental_cost, 0)                              AS estimated_rental_cost,
       NVL(mc.misc_cost, 0)                                    AS misc_transaction_cost,
       NVL(pc.posted_cost, 0)                                  AS posted_project_cost,
       NVL(lc.est_rental_cost, 0)
         + NVL(mc.misc_cost, 0)
         + NVL(pc.posted_cost, 0)                              AS total_cost_of_ownership
FROM   EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER em
       LEFT JOIN line_cost   lc ON lc.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID = em.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID
       LEFT JOIN misc_cost   mc ON mc.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID = em.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID
       LEFT JOIN posted_cost pc ON pc.EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID     = em.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID
WHERE  em.EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_ID IN (:equipment_master_ids)
ORDER  BY total_cost_of_ownership DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
